summary: First test iteration of DropKit MVP. 17/17 backend tests pass after test data corrections (board field, INTERMEDIATE uppercase). Frontend home page renders with all expected sections (LAUNCHING SOON badge, 10 FAQ items expandable, waitlist form working with confirmation toast). All 5 routes navigate without errors. Gift redeem with invalid code shows error. /account page shows content but did not match strict 'sign-in required' regex (minor copy verification).

issues: One 404 console resource error logged (likely favicon/asset) - non-blocking
Page renders but copy did not match 'sign-in required' literal — may use different wording like 'Connect your Shopify account' (verify wording in copy)

action_items: (Optional) Verify /account empty-state copy matches product requirement wording.
(Optional) Investigate single 404 console error on home page (likely a missing static asset).
critical_code_review_comments: routes_public.py is 380 lines — acceptable but approaching the split threshold; consider splitting into separate routers (waitlist, projects, votes, substitutions, gifts, account, faq).
routes_public.py has unused helpers `require_admin` and `_gen_gift_code` (dead code, since real ones live in routes_admin.py / routes_webhooks.py).
/api/projects/current returns null (200) but FastAPI lacks an explicit response_model — fine for now but consider Optional[ProjectOut].

Webhook handler intentionally bypasses HMAC when SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET starts with PLACEHOLDER — documented and acceptable for MVP, but log/warn at startup so this is not deployed accidentally to prod.
/api/substitutions endpoint enforces day-of-month <= 10 server-side using server clock — good. UI should also surface this rule.
ProjectCreate requires `board` and Literal `difficulty` — schema is strict; admin UI must enforce same constraints to avoid 422s.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows OK, one minor 404 console warning)

test_credentials: Admin token: dropkit-admin-dev-token (X-Admin-Token header). No user/auth tokens (Shopify session JWT) tested — placeholder credentials per design.
seed_data_creation: Backend test creates a transient project via admin API and deletes it after assertion. Waitlist test inserts one row per run (idempotent on duplicates). Webhook test inserts a user/order row for shopifyCustomerId=12345.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 17 pytest tests pass against the live preview URL. Project schema requires fields: slug,title,description,board,difficulty(literal 'INTERMEDIATE'|'ADV. INTERMEDIATE'),cycleMonth,cycleYear. Admin token header is X-Admin-Token. Webhook HMAC bypass works because SHOPIFY_WEBHOOK_SECRET starts with PLACEHOLDER. Frontend routes verified: /, /apps/makerbox/projects, /apps/makerbox/vote, /pages/redeem-gift, /pages/faq, /account.
rca_of_the_issue: Initial test failures were due to test-side payload mismatches (missing required `board`, wrong-case `difficulty`, and use of reserved `.test` TLD in waitlist email). Fixed in test file — not code bugs.
